subject.title: fix(agents): classify Anthropic invalid_request_error as format for failover

question: Should every structured `invalid_request_error` payload trigger configured model fallback, including errors caused by malformed user or tool requests?
rationale: The patch intentionally broadens provider-routing behavior beyond the reported Anthropic thinking-block case, and code evidence cannot determine whether that cross-model fallback policy is desired for all request-validation failures.

options.title: Approve broad fallback
options.body: Treat all structured invalid-request payloads like equivalent HTTP 400 format failures, after restoring the separate schema diagnostic.

options.title: Narrow known cases
options.body: Fallback only for identified recoverable Anthropic-compatible rejection patterns while leaving other invalid requests terminal.

options.title: Pause the policy change
options.body: Keep current routing until a provider-aware or error-code-aware fallback contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve broad fallback
recommendation.body: Treat all structured invalid-request payloads like equivalent HTTP 400 format failures, after restoring the separate schema diagnostic.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work introduced the typed runtime classification contract most directly affected by the policy and diagnostic interaction.
